messages:
maya: quick check — prepping the quickstart cutover. README lint failing in sampleapps/sample-payments and one unit test is erroring. changelog cutoff is tomorrow EOD, who owns sample-payments right now?
owen: i'm the owner for sample-payments. saw lint errors this morning, pushing a small fix now. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4123
ci-bot: build started for PR #4123 -> running unit_tests and lint
owen: fix is basically whitespace + import path tweak. snippet: `require('./fixtures/card.json')` -> `require('../fixtures/card.json')`
luis: that import path change came from my fixture reshuffle branch. oops, forgot to update tests that reference relative path. i can rebase and push a tiny patch if you want, @owen.
owen: rebased with luis's patch, pushed commit, kicked CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/7789
ci-bot: build failed -> unit_tests error: "Error: Cannot find module '../fixtures/card.json'" (occurs in sample-payments/test/payment.test.js)
luis: ah, the test loader expects fixtures in `sampleapps/sample-payments/fixtures/`, my branch put them under `shared-fixtures/`. quick fix: add a small loader fallback in the tests. i'll open a patch now.
tara: quick heads-up — changelog cutoff is 18:00 PST tomorrow. if this is going to block the quickstart release, we should prioritize merge now. who can merge once green?
maya: i can hold the changelog entry, but need someone to merge and bump the package version. @owen can you merge after CI passes?
owen: yes i can merge and do the version bump + tag. will wait for green.
luis: pushed loader fallback (adds `try { require('../fixtures/...') } catch(e) { require('../../shared-fixtures/...') }`). small, covered by existing tests. kicked CI again.
ci-bot: build succeeded ✅ (unit_tests + lint) for PR #4123
owen: great. added a 2-line docs note in `docs/quickstarts/sample-payments/README.md` about fixture locations. can someone do a quick docs review?
tara: i'll do the docs review. also please add a one-line changelog blurb: "Fix sample-payments quickstart README lint + test fixture path" under quickstarts.
maya: @tara awesome — i'll draft the changelog entry and open a PR to the changelog repo. who will bump package.json and tag?
owen: i'll take package bump and tagging after merge. i'll follow semver patch: v0.14.2 -> v0.14.3-quickstart.
luis: FYI the sampleapp demo video depends on this test passing for the e2e run. if merge is delayed i'll flip demo to use staging artifact to avoid last-minute break.
tara: ack. i'll review docs now, expect review + approve in ~15m.
maya: checklist for quickstart cutover: 1) merge PR 2) bump quickstart package version 3) tag release 4) trigger docs site deploy 5) add changelog entry. who takes 4 and 5?
owen: i'll do (2) & (3). maya can open the docs-deploy issue for (4) and I'll ping infra if it needs manual kick.
maya: created docs issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/89 — will request deploy once release tag exists.
tara: merged PR, squashed and merged to main, tag created v0.14.3-quickstart. changelog PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/210 — I'll drop a short note in #release-tracker.
maya: thanks all! last step: product confirmation on wording. pinging product async. closing loop here — everyone OK with the rollout? :thumbsup:
owen: :thumbsup: all good from my side.
luis: good to go, i'll update demo to use new artifact.
ci-bot: release tag v0.14.3-quickstart created by owen at 3135312749
